name: Otnox
description: Search live public procurement notices across 40+ markets in Europe, Latin America and Africa. Filter tenders by country, category, status and value; open full tender details with buyer information, deadlines and links to the official source. Every notice comes from the country's official procurement portal, refreshed daily. Requires a free Otnox account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Otnox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Otnox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.otnox.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Otnox MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otnox provides these MCP tools: get_buyer_profile, get_competition_signals, get_tender_details, qualify_opportunity, and search_tenders.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Otnox?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Otnox in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Otnox requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Otnox is developed by Otnox. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
